title: Objectives:  string name="troubleshooting_hint3" still references link to old AAPS Gitter room
body:
**Aindrond APS 3.0**

_examl.xml:_
string name="troubleshooting_hint3" still references link to old AAPS Gitter room at https://gitter.im/MilosKozak/AndroidAPS

Should be replaced with link to Discord as mentioned on Gitter Feb 20, 2022:
_"The chat has moved. Please join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/4fQUWHZ4Mw"_
